The '''Imberlin system''' was located in the [[Imberlin sector/Legends|Imberlin sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> an independent [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] ran afoul of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] authorities in the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. The [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Findsman/Legends|findsman]] [[Lu'daal-ud]] subsequently captured the trader, in the process acquiring the merchant's [[Sigma-class shuttle|shuttle]], the ''[[Mist Laden]]''.<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imberlin system was first mentioned in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AIR" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square P-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
